title: Can we talk about the elevators?
content: Holy shit, those elevators are the worst part for me. I don’t feel fear on the water, crazy stairs, or dark spaces…but *those elevators*. It’s weird because they rarely drop, it’s because they freakin’ shoot UP. And the shaking and lurching. Absolutely terrifying. The elevators seem to be in the hotel or office building. The light intensifies as the elevator barrels upwards and often ends up outside the building on the roof. Poop, now I’m probably going to have one of those visits tonight.
